video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Jenni hands The Rubber Duck the co-host seat and opens with a fresh scare headline, the kind that arrives every few weeks. What follows is a long, unhurried working session on 2020, the coming election and which voices online are worth listening to.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: A long Monday that starts overseas and ends up on the doorstep: elections in Russia, Brazil and India, his own corner of South Florida, and the Epstein thread he keeps returning to. Listener questions carry the back half.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: It opens on airline headlines and an old piece of cockpit technology, then works outward to government websites, a list called NESARA, fuel at the pump, and a listener's question about Israel's future.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Jenni opens with a prime-time message from the president, then gives The Rubber Duck the floor to argue what the election conversation should actually be about. Callers push back and question him, and it closes on schools and the farm.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: An hour on screens, words and the mind: how broadcast images reach the part of us that decides, and the daily habit The Rubber Duck uses to break the pull. Callers join from as far as Ireland before the hour is out.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Jenni and The Rubber Duck take stock of where things stand, from the people who stepped away to a 2018 drop he says is speaking again. The second half belongs to the callers.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Presidents past, a well-known online voice, election turnout and the night the Q boards went dark. A wide-ranging session with callers adding threads of their own along the way.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Recorded on September 11 itself, this one is given over almost entirely to that day: the buildings, the footage, and the questions The Rubber Duck still carries. Callers bring their own memories and theories.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Picking up mid-conversation, this one stays on what ends up on our plates and in our data: slaughterhouses and backyard eggs, Palantir, and the data centers going up. Callers turn it toward the news of the week.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: The Rubber Duck on breaking the spell of fear, and on what he calls the red folder. Then a long line of callers with warnings, wildfire news from Nevada and questions about the northern border.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Jenni is back behind the mic, and The Rubber Duck joins her for a session that runs from Q being talked about openly again to the Middle East, new energy, and what 2020 still means.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Jenni calls him the SERIEZ because he is a series of information, and this one earns it: judging a source, the symbols to watch, the midterms, and an old Wall Street story a caller opens up.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: The Rubber Duck opens on a fresh round of declassified files and why this release was handled differently from the ones before it. A busy panel of callers follows, with stops in the news of the week.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Eleven minutes of a false start. Jenni opens the sixth season of the Revival of America from a new computer setup, and most of the recording goes to getting The Rubber Duck onto the co-host mic before she restarts the space.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Fresh off the Fourth of July, the talk turns to what the country might look like after Trump, how a source should show its work, and how far an executive order on elections could reach.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Jenni announces a new recurring guest focused on technology, then The Rubber Duck walks through how he reads Washington's power structure. Callers bring Fourth of July plans, news from Iraq and the Q clock into the mix.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: With the White House UFC event still fresh, The Rubber Duck reads it as a ceremony to be decoded, and the hour widens from there: Freemasonry and the founding, gestures at award shows, shipping chokepoints, and what new data centers might really be.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: It opens with a song and an album in the works, then turns to the long script The Rubber Duck sees behind Trump's moves, a wave of alien and Epstein disclosures, and how the races in a liberal city are shifting.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Jenni and The Rubber Duck start on the format of the show itself and the debaters who drift into friendly spaces, then move through a history he no longer trusts, the news of Tina Peters's release, and the tech figures who passed through Trump Tower.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck: Happy Memorial Day
video:video.video:description: On Memorial Day, Jenni shares a schedule change for her lineup, and The Rubber Duck traces how every thread he follows leads back to 2020. A Rumble viewer asks how he first came to Q.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: The longest recording in this room, at more than two and a half hours. That buys time to go from the Nephilim and an AI alien video to the end of the 4chan era, the Templars, and the line between misinformation and disinformation.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: The Monday after Mother's Day: Jenni asks what stands out, and the answer runs from a virus scare and vetting headlines to Trump's early Asia trip, the UFO files and his Red Pill album.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Jenni opens with the end of the royal visit and a new inbox for listener stories, then The Rubber Duck takes the hour through Trump's role, the first days of COVID and the advisers around the first campaign. A long line of callers takes over from there.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Recorded while the royal visit was still under way in Washington, this shorter session has The Rubber Duck reading symbols in it, a weekend shooting, and a Q post on counterinsurgency, then the military's quiet role and the music he has been making.

video:video.video:title: Live with John Baxter: Anti-Aging Med Bed
video:video.video:description: Jenni sits down with John Baxter for a shorter live show about med beds: what he says his team has been demonstrating for years, the scams trading on his name, and where he thinks health care is heading.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: This one picks up with the conversation already under way, as the two weigh talk of coming arrests and a new attorney general. Callers then carry it to JFK Jr., Lin Wood's long record, Five Eyes and the correspondents' dinner.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: A picture Trump posted sets the agenda. The Rubber Duck reads it alongside Iran and his own days on the old Q boards, while callers, from longtime listeners to a self-described newcomer, press him on what he believes and how he knows it.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: A presidential press conference on Iran is under way as the show opens, so Jenni plays it live and The Rubber Duck spends the rest unpacking it: the CIA director, a leaked rescue, the strait, and the numbers anons match to old drops.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck: JFK Jr.
video:video.video:description: Billed around JFK Jr., it opens on the 1999 crash and a Senate race that never happened, then turns to General Flynn, X22 Dave and how the old boards really worked. Callers weigh in from both sides.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: It opens with an election bill in the news and becomes a tour of the disclosure story as The Rubber Duck sees it. A full bench of callers trade questions and videos to share.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: It starts with the signal coming out of every screen and the books leaders keep on the shelf, then runs through the Middle East, what our reactions are worth to the other side, and a 2012 change to broadcast law.

video:video.video:title: The SERIEZ w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Well over two hours, enough room to lay out how The Rubber Duck thinks the system was built and how it is being taken apart. Dr. James joins with his own account of September 11, then a long run of callers.

video:video.video:title: Real Raw Talk w/ The Rubber Duck
video:video.video:description: Jenni and Carmen host a long Real Raw Talk that moves from reading Trump's crumbs to the limbo of the last ten years, then opens the room to callers asking about Vance, old drops and the early days.

video:video.video:title: Live with The Rubber Duck: 9/11 and Much More
video:video.video:description: The earliest Rumble recording in this room, in which The Rubber Duck tells Jenni where he was on September 11 and how that day led him, years later, to Q. Callers fill the second hour.
